name: CHAMS HOLDING COMPANY PLC
source: H1 2026 (period ended 30th June 2026, unaudited) added from Chams Holding Company Plc unaudited consolidated and separate financial statements 30 June 2026 (NGX doclib); N'000 x1000. Group column. EPS left blank: the filing's EPS row could not be aligned to the 6-month Group column. | CHAMS Holding Company Plc audited consolidated financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025, Group Financial Summary page 77, printed in thousands of naira; values stored below as absolute naira. Rows the audited summary does not print (Cost of Sales, Gross Profit, Operating Expenses, EBIT, Net Finance Costs) are left absent rather than carried over from the previous misaligned columns. | CRON 20261005: added Operating Expenses, Operating Profit (EBIT) and Net Finance Costs from the audited consolidated statement of profit or loss, page 13 of the FY2025 annual report (Group column, N thousands, stored as absolute naira). Operating Expenses is the sum of the printed selling and marketing, employees and other related, depreciation and amortisation, and administrative expense lines. Net Finance Costs is the printed interest expense less the printed interest income. Ties: 3,759,704 gross profit plus 439,196 other operating income less 2,828,251 operating expenses equals 1,370,649 operating profit; 1,370,649 less 563,885 equals 806,764 profit before tax; 806,764 less 389,671 income tax equals 417,093 profit for the year, and FY2024 ties at every step. The stored Revenue row holds the printed Gross earnings figure, so no Cost of Sales or Gross Profit row is stored and the Revenue less Cost of Sales identity is deliberately not asserted for this issuer. | FILL 20261007: H1 2026 cells added from Chams Holding Company Plc unaudited consolidated and separate financial statements for the period ended 30 June 2026 (NGX doclib, statement of profit or loss, page 3), Group six months ended 30 June 2026 column, printed in N'000 and stored as absolute naira. Ties exactly: revenue 9,788,763 less cost of sales 7,222,313 equals gross profit 2,566,450; gross profit plus other operating income 14,319 less administrative expenses 2,052,124 equals operating profit 528,645; 528,645 less finance expense 460,677 plus finance income 538,787 equals profit before taxation 606,755; 606,755 less taxation 133,476 equals profit after taxation 473,279. EPS stays blank: the filing prints interleaved columns and its earnings per share row cannot be aligned to the six month Group column. | FILL 20261007_192730: Basic earnings per share 5.26 kobo for the six months ended 30 June 2026, Group column, printed page 3 of the filing. The filing interleaves four Group and four Company columns; the value right edge (568pt) matches the Group 6-month 2026 column (565-568pt), not the 3-month or Company columns. Ties: profit after taxation 473,279 thousand divided by the 9,000,000,000 shares used for the stored FY2025 EPS gives 0.05259. Source: https://doclib.ngxgroup.com/Financial_NewsDocs/47664_CHAMS_HOLDING_COMPANY_PLC-_QUARTER_2_-_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_FOR_2026_FINANCIAL_STATEMENTS_JULY_2026.pdf | FILL 20261007: H1 2026 ratios derived from the matching H1 2026 balance sheet already stored (total assets 35,744,117,000; total liabilities 15,751,964,000; total equity 19,992,153,000) and the stored H1 2026 net profit of 473,279,000. ROE 473,279/19,992,153; ROA 473,279/35,744,117; Debt to Equity 15,751,964/19,992,153.

source_note: EPS stored in base currency (NGN), NOT the kobo the audited summary prints. FY2025 EPS 0.046341 = profit for the year 417,093,000 / 9,000,000,000 shares outstanding, which is the value the file's own market cap (29,070,000,000 over 9,000,000,000 shares = 3.23 per share) and P/E (69.7) reconcile to, and the value at which shares x EPS equals the net profit the P/E divides by. The audited summary prints 5.78 kobo, computed on the profit attributable to owners of the parent (520,640,000), a profit line this file's net profit row (profit for the year, 417,093,000) does not carry, so the printed kobo cell is a 100x unit error against the base currency and is not the value to publish. Corrected by the EPS-unit audit (_fix_eps_units.py, ledger 2026-10-06): the P/E cross-check closed from 'differ by 20%' to agree. Rebuilt 2026-10-02 from the filed annual report held in _ngx_pdf.
